messages:
lee_support: Heads-up — NeuroLearn pilot org can't finish onboarding. New users stuck at "invite sent" step, never appear in active roster. Customer reported at 11:12 UTC and says it's blocking their classroom kickoff tomorrow.

lee_support: quick log snippet we have from the invite worker:
```text
[2026-03-22T11:09:55Z] INVITE_FAILED org=neurolearn-pilot-01 user=teacher@neurolearn.edu err=PROVISIONING_BLOCKED reason=domain_blocklist
```

ops_bot: Ticket created: TCK-7765; severity=high; routed to eng-runtime.

nina_cs: I'm on comms. Who owns the domain allowlist change? Did we push a policy update this morning? Need list of affected orgs and POC emails. Also raising renewal chatter — pilot is in-run; if this isn't resolved before demo, renewal probability drops.

lee_support: Affected: neurolearn-pilot-01, neurolearn-trial-05. Reporter: teacher@neurolearn.edu (ux lead). Change was from security team's bulk update at 09:45 UTC — they added several edu domains to the blocklist. Added link to support ticket with diff.

omar_prod: Confirmed: security pushed domain_blocklist release (roll #db-2026-03-22-3). That deploy included a new strict-match rule which inadvertently matched our edu invite domains. Root cause: overly greedy regex in config. I can roll a hotfix to loosen the rule or we can whitelist the two orgs. Minimal command to whitelist: 
```bash
redwood-admin org-config set --org neurolearn-pilot-01 --key domain_blocklist_override --value true
```
I recommend a quick whitelist + patch to config and then revert override. Need support signoff to apply org-level override.

taylor_am: Please apply whitelist now. We're on a tryout renewal path and demo scheduled 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll take ownership of the customer note: short apology + mitigation + ask to join quick sync. Also adding renewal flag in SFDC.

lee_support: I've prepared CR-9021 to authorize the whitelist toggle for both orgs. Attaching logs and support notes.

omar_prod: Executing whitelist for the two orgs now. Posting results.

omar_prod: Done — `domain_blocklist_override=true` for neurolearn-pilot-01 and neurolearn-trial-05. Re-ran invite flow: 202 ACCEPTED -> 200 OK -> user appears in roster.

nina_cs: Thank you. Draft comms (short): 
1) we apologize for the disruption; brief cause (safety rule update matched your domain)
2) we've applied a temporary whitelist so invites now work
3) propose 20-min check-in tomorrow before demo to validate flows and review any domain needs
4) ask about expected number of seats and whether they'd like a temporary bump ahead of scheduled renewal.

lee_support: Support will keep TCK-7765 open until permanent fix rolled. I also added note to the pilot record in SFDC: "domain rule caused invite blockage; temporary whitelist applied".

ops_bot: TCK-7765 status -> mitigated; patch scheduled: db-2026-03-22-3-rollforward-fix.

taylor_am: Scheduling 09:00 PT sync invite now; will include product and CS. Nina, I'll send the comms copy for signoff. I'll also prepare an uplift offer (one-month temporary seat bump) to avoid renewal friction.

nina_cs: Good plan. Recap actions: (1) CS send comms + schedule sync (nina_cs/taylor_am) (2) Eng patch config to remove greedy match (omar_prod) (3) Support keep ticket open and monitor (lee_support) (4) AM propose temporary seat uplift if needed (taylor_am). I'll update the pilot's risk tag in the renewal tracker. :white_check_mark:

lee_support: Copy. Leaving monitoring hooks for invite worker alerts and will post if anything recurs.

omar_prod: I'll follow up once patch is live and confirm closing TCK-7765.
